product.name: Phone Call Translator App
product.description: An app that provides real-time translation of phone calls into 30+ languages, preserving the speaker's voice, tone, and emotions during conversations.

product.name: Voice Message Translator
product.description: A service that translates incoming and outgoing voice messages instantly while maintaining the sender's voice tone and emotions across languages.

product.name: Text Message Translator
product.description: An app feature that automatically translates incoming and outgoing text messages in real-time without requiring users to switch between apps.

product.name: Google Meet Voice Translation Extension
product.description: A Google Chrome extension that translates Google Meet meetings in real-time into 20+ languages, preserving the speaker's voice, tone, and emotions.

product.name: EzDubs Voice Translation API
product.description: An API that enables integration of EzDubs' real-time voice and text translation capabilities into third-party platforms and applications.
